title: Rooftop jet route to roof loot
brief: Single change: plan a jet/jump climb onto a roof (≤ ~60 m reachable with 100 energy, protocol.md:282-287) to take crates/loot that spawn on roofs (about a quarter of them), when no enemy is in view and the zone allows. The champion's nav is ground-only (nav.ts:16-17); jets are used only as a stuck escape (brain.ts:875-877). It must be separate from B125's TAC_JET_LOOT (site 3.50 bundled pack): explain how it differs. Early activation count first (stop under 10/192), then the full BUILD_CHECKLIST, with a flag-ON head.
source: mechanics research directive (Doug 8:06 PM ET), coord/next-doug.md 5404931
decision: Recorded 8:18 PM ET per Doug: build after P38.
